cands.name: island_1
cands.comment: 活潑的熱帶島嶼風格烏克麗麗背景音樂。

cands.name: island_2
cands.comment: 這是一段充滿熱帶島嶼風情的輕快背景音樂。

cands.name: island_s1
cands.comment: 一首充滿熱帶島嶼風情的輕快活潑音樂循環。

cands.name: island_3
cands.comment: 這是一首充滿熱帶風情、節奏活潑的歡快背景音樂。

cands.name: island_s2
cands.comment: 這是一首帶有烏克麗麗和鋼鼓的活潑熱帶島嶼音樂。

bgm.use: 積木／翻牌／青蛙（溫和思考）

cands.name: calm_3
cands.comment: 一首溫暖平和的管弦樂，旋律清晰，適合安靜的益智遊戲。

cands.name: calm_2
cands.comment: 溫暖柔和的鋼琴與弦樂，適合益智遊戲，但循環接點不順暢。

cands.name: calm_1
cands.comment: 溫馨的兒童音樂，但音檔中段有人聲浮水印，無法使用。

cands.name: town_3
cands.comment: 這是一首節奏輕快、帶有放克風格的背景音樂。

cands.name: town_2
cands.comment: 這是一首節奏穩定、氛圍輕鬆愉快的輕放克風格樂曲。

cands.name: town_1
cands.comment: 這是一首輕鬆愉快的放克音樂，節奏穩定，非常適合當作背景音樂。

cands.name: rainbow_3
cands.comment: 這是一首夢幻溫柔的管弦樂，帶有豎琴與鐘聲，非常適合奇幻遊戲的選單畫面。

cands.name: rainbow_1
cands.comment: 這是一首夢幻而愉快的管弦樂，非常適合魔法主題的遊戲選單。

cands.name: rainbow_2
cands.comment: 這是一首夢幻快樂的魔法風管弦樂，帶有豎琴與鐘聲，非常適合奇幻主題。

cands.name: night_1
cands.comment: 這是一首溫柔祥和、充滿夢幻感的管弦樂搖籃曲。

cands.name: night_3
cands.comment: 這是一首溫柔夢幻、氣氛祥和的管弦搖籃曲。

cands.name: night_2
cands.comment: 這是一首溫柔夢幻的搖籃曲，但循環的接點非常明顯。

cands.name: road_2
cands.comment: 這是一首充滿活力的民謠風木吉他音樂，節奏輕快。

cands.name: road_3
cands.comment: 輕快活潑的旋律，適合開車兜風的遊戲場景。

cands.name: road_1
cands.comment: 這是一首充滿活力與歡快感的背景音樂，節奏輕快，非常適合兒童遊戲。

cands.name: dress_3
cands.comment: 輕快俏皮的旋律，充滿童趣的氛圍。

cands.name: dress_1
cands.comment: 這是一段活潑俏皮、充滿時尚感的電子流行音樂。

cands.name: dress_2
cands.comment: 這是一首活潑可愛的電子童趣音樂，但循環的接縫處非常明顯。

cands.name: bubble_1
cands.comment: 這是一首輕鬆愉快的背景音樂，非常適合水底世界的氛圍。

cands.name: bubble_2
cands.comment: 旋律溫和悅耳，充滿夢幻的水中氣氛。

cands.name: bubble_3
cands.comment: 這是一段帶有夢幻水感的愉快電子流行樂循環。

party.name: synth_fanfare
party.comment: 這段音效活潑可愛，非常適合勝利畫面。

party.name: lyria_clip1_cut
party.comment: 這段音樂非常歡快，很適合勝利畫面。

party.name: lyria_clip2_cut
party.comment: 這段音樂充滿了歡樂的慶祝氣氛。

sfx.name: coin
sfx.check: A magical, sparkly chime sound, like a video game coin pickup.

sfx.name: door
sfx.check: A wooden door creaks open and the latch clicks loudly.

sfx.name: flip
sfx.check: A quick, crisp whoosh and snap of a page turning.

sfx.name: gacha_crank
sfx.check: A very fast, sharp, mechanical ratchet crank turning quickly.

sfx.name: hatch
sfx.check: A cartoon pop, rapid bird chirps, and a final positive chime.

sfx.name: lever
sfx.check: A sharp latch click followed by a solid mechanical clunk.

sfx.name: load
sfx.check: A short, sharp thud of a heavy object being dropped.

sfx.name: ng
sfx.check: A soft, two-note descending marimba or xylophone sound.

sfx.name: ok
sfx.check: A short, happy, ascending synth chime for a correct answer.

sfx.name: select
sfx.check: A short, clean, descending synthesized blip or select sound.

sfx.name: sticker
sfx.check: A magical, sparkly, shimmering chime sound effect for a reward.

sfx.name: tap
sfx.check: A soft, gentle, slightly bubbly user interface tap or click.

sfx.name: unload
sfx.check: A short, sharp thud of a wooden crate being set down.

sfx.name: unlock
sfx.check: A click followed by a short, rising, synthesized chime melody.

sfx.name: wear
sfx.check: A quick cloth rustle followed by a magical sparkle chime.

sfx.name: whoosh
sfx.check: A fast, clean whoosh or swoosh sound effect.

compare.note: Freesound CC0：Staten Island Ferry Horn.mp3 by nathanvladimirovich｜決賽 Pro 正反都選新版｜Clip A has a warm, realistic resonance that is gentle on the ears, making it much better suited for a children's game.
